key_insight: Atomistic simulations predict transient all-optical reversal in GdCo with just 1.5 at.% Gd, far from compensation, when Gd couples much more weakly to the thermal bath than Co.
engineering_relevance: Engineering species-dependent spin–bath coupling could enable low-Gd magnetic layers for ultrafast optical switching.
method: Simulated laser-driven dynamics using atomistic spin models under uniform heating.
Compared a three-monolayer Co film with surface-confined Gd against a uniformly alloyed three-dimensional GdCo model.
Varied Gd concentration, species-dependent spin–bath coupling, and pulse parameters.
evidence_signal: For selected pulse parameters, simulations showed transient toggle-like reversal down to 1.5 at.% total Gd, with faster reversal at higher Gd content.
watch_item: Transient reversal does not establish stable final-state switching; experimental validation requires optical absorption, stack-dependent heat flow, and dipolar fields.
paper_title: Atomistic Insights into the All-Optical Switching of GdCo Alloys with Minimal Gd Concentration
